{{Current events|year=2019|month=03|day=9|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**[[Rakhine people|Rakhine]] insurgents of the [[Arakan Army (Kachin State)|Arakan Army]] attack a police post in a village in [[Rakhine State]], killing nine policemen. All of the victims were local recruits from the village. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rakhine/rakhine-rebels-kill-nine-in-fresh-strike-on-myanmar-police-official-idUSKBN1QR06B (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Japan]]ese supercentenarian [[Kane Tanaka]] is officially recognized as the world's [[List of the oldest living people|oldest living person]] at 116 years and 67 days old. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/mar/09/japanese-woman-116-named-worlds-oldest-living-person (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Colombia DC-3 crash]]
**A [[DC-3]] operated by Laser Aereo crashes in [[Colombia]] en-route from [[Jorge Enrique González Torres Airport|San José del Guaviare]], killing all 14 aboard. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-colombia-crash/colombia-plane-crash-kills-12-police-source-idUSKBN1QQ0MK (Reuters)] [https://www.elespectador.com/noticias/nacional/meta/falla-de-motor-posible-causa-de-accidente-de-avion-en-meta-articulo-844103 (''El Espectador'')]
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**[[2019 Venezuelan blackout]]
***Whilst a nationwide [[Power outage|power blackout]] continues, Acting President [[Juan Guaidó]] calls for protests in the capital of [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuelas-guaido-calls-for-massive-protest-as-blackout-drags-on-idUSKBN1QQ0DC (Reuters)] [http://time.com/5548648/venezuela-protest-power-outage/ (''Time'')]
***With a fire causing new damage to a power plant in [[Bolívar (state)|Bolívar State]], President [[Nicolás Maduro]] states the power outages are "caused by U.S.-backed sabotage"; Guaidó says the outages are due to Maduro government "corruption and mismanagement". [https://www.msn.com/en-au/kids/other/thousands-join-rival-protests-on-streets-of-venezuela-as-power-cuts-continue/ar-BBUzLJ5?li=AA4RE4&%252525252525253Bocid=ientp (MSN)] [https://www.sfgate.com/world/article/More-blackouts-hit-Venezuela-as-opposition-13676368.php (SFGate)]
*A [[Japan]]ese high-speed [[boat]] collides with a "marine creature" while carrying 121 passengers; 87 passengers are injured and 5 airlifted by helicopter to the hospital. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/09/asia/japan-marine-creature-boat-crash-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2018–19 South-West Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**The floods from the predecessor of Cyclone Idai cause 23 deaths and 11 missing in southern [[Malawi]]. [http://www.maravipost.com/tragedy-twenty-three-dead-11-missing-29-severely-injured-due-to-floods-in-malawi/ (''The Maravi Post'')]
*Around 40 fishermen are rescued by the [[United States Coast Guard]] after an [[ice sheet]] breaks away on [[Lake Erie]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/over-40-ice-fishermen-rescued-after-ice-floe-breaks-lake-n981436 (NBC)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/dozens-rescued-after-being-trapped-on-lake-erie-ice-floe/2019/03/09/b70faf90-42a3-11e9-85ad-779ef05fd9d8_story.html?utm_term=.61238aed0bfbv (''The Washington Post'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Salamanca nightclub shooting]]
**A [[mass shooting]] at a [[nightclub]] in [[Salamanca, Guanajuato|Salamanca]], [[Guanajuato]], [[Mexico]], kills at least 15 people and leaves another seven people wounded. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-violence/at-least-15-killed-in-a-nightclub-shooting-in-violent-mexico-state-idUSKBN1QQ0GJ (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Health in Tunisia|Tunisian health minister]] Abderraouf Cherif resigns following the deaths of 11 newborn babies since Thursday at a hospital in the capital [[Tunis]].  Evidence suggests all 11 died from [[septic shock]].  Tunisia's public healthcare had been considered one of the best in [[North Africa]], but it has operated less smoothly since the [[Tunisian Revolution|2011 revolution]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47511984 (BBC)]
*[[Prime Minister of Peru]] [[Cesar Villanueva]] resigns after falling approval ratings. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/03/peru-pm-cesar-villanueva-resigns-falling-popularity-190309052253135.html (''Al Jazeera'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-peru-politics/perus-pm-to-resign-as-president-seeks-ratings-boost-sources-idUSKBN1QP29L (Reuters)]
